# Step 1: compute target songs (liked AND in album library)
spotify_creds = [c for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify']
spotify_pw = spotify_creds[0]['password']
spotify_email = 'jes.mill@gmail.com'
login_doc = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_email, password=spotify_pw)
token = login_doc['access_token']

# liked songs (paginated)
liked_songs=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

liked_song_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs}

# album library songs (paginated)
all_albums=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by=None, query='')
    if not page:
        break
    all_albums.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

album_song_ids=set()
for a in all_albums:
    for sid in a.get('song_ids',[]) or []:
        album_song_ids.add(sid)

# intersection
target_song_ids = sorted(list(liked_song_ids & album_song_ids))
print('liked songs:', len(liked_song_ids))
print('album library unique songs:', len(album_song_ids))
print('target songs (liked ∩ in album library):', len(target_song_ids))
print('target song ids:', target_song_ids)
